title: AI Engineering Expert (Advisory Role)
description:
GlenFlow is a US-based venture studio and technology company with a strong Upwork track record and consistent 5-star reviews.

We're looking for senior engineering professionals who help software teams improve how they develop with AI.

This is not simply a training role — you'll assess how a team works today, identify where AI can help or create challenges, and recommend practical improvements.

What You'll Do
* Assess SDLC, AI usage, and bottlenecks with Engineering Managers, Leads, and CTOs
* Design AI-driven workflows for development, testing, code review, and documentation
* Set up AI coding tools, agents, MCP, shared prompts, and repository context
* Move teams from individual AI use to repeatable team-level practices
* Measure impact and recommend next steps
* Present findings to engineering leadership and help shape follow-up work

Who We're Looking For
* 7+ years in software engineering or engineering leadership (Engineering Manager, Lead, Staff/Principal, Director/Head of Engineering)
* Professional experience applying AI tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Codex, or similar) to engineering teams
* Strong client-facing skills and excellent English - you lead the technical conversation
* Coding experience is a plus; this is not a development role

Experience with every tool is not required - we value understanding of AI-driven workflows over any specific tool.

Engagement
Part-time, project-based, variable hours.
Some months may involve only a few hours; active projects may require 20+ hours.
Meetings are mostly during North American business hours. We pay competitive rates and have a strong history of 5-star freelancer relationships on Upwork.

To Apply
Attach your CV with contact details removed (email, phone, address, LinkedIn, other links) and briefly describe:
* How you've applied AI to software engineering and developer productivity
* The AI tools and workflows you've worked with
* One or two examples of improving a team's AI adoption or productivity
